aios-aios:ashbyhq:e0971cdd-b061-4530-ae6.description: ABOUT AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor. We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://www.notion.so/fella/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?source=copy_link THE OPPORTUNITY AS HEAD OF PRODUCT GROWTH (REFERRALS & VIRAL LOOPS) We’re building a world-class team. As Head of Product Growth at AIOS, your fundamental role is to engineer viral growth. I expect us to reach >0.3 30-Day K Factor (our Primary KPI). This is critical work for us to scale from 100k active customers today to 10 million customers by 2030. You’ll start by taking over our referral program and transforming it into a true viral growth system. You’ll lead a team of engineers + designers, and work closely with the CEO. You’ll ship daily, test aggressively, and iterate with AI tools faster than most product teams can finish scoping. Over time, your work will expand across every product surface that can drive viral growth: referrals, invite loops, UGC, social sharing, gifting, visible product moments, freemium, and weird ideas no one has tried yet. You’ll build a cracked team under you to execute this. This is a founder-builder role. You’ll act with high autonomy. We want someone who thinks distribution is a product problem, moves fast, has strong consumer taste, and knows how to create loops that make people want to share. If you nail the role, you’ll continue to lead everything in Product Growth. If you’re truly excellent, you’ll be a leading candidate for our future CPO or CGO roles. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice. You must be around until midday Pacific Time every weekday to have enough crossover with me. This is a senior role. You’ll report directly to me, Richie :) (our CEO https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright). I’m intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends. You’ll work most closely with me (Richie, CEO https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright/), our VP Growth (Rick Singh https://www.linkedin.com/in/richiesingh/), our Head of Product (Ben Dowdle https://www.linkedin.com/in/bendowdle/), and our VP Engineering (Gzim Helshani https://www.linkedin.com/in/ghels/). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AREAS 📈 ”A startup is a company designed to grow fast. The only essential thing is growth. If you get growth, everything else tends to fall into place.” Overall: You’ll build viral loops that cause customers to bring in other customers. assistworld-assist-world:lever:0d8725e3-.description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced Paraplanner / Client Relationship Manager to join a growing US-based wealth management firm. This is a full-time remote position where you'll play a key role in supporting a busy Financial Advisor, helping to deliver an exceptional client experience while taking ownership of day-to-day planning and relationship management responsibilities. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with financial planning experience who enjoys working directly with clients and wants to become an integral part of a growing advisory practice. Key Responsibilities ● Act as the primary point of contact for client service enquiries. ● Build and maintain strong relationships with clients through phone, email and virtual meetings. ● Prepare and support financial plans using eMoney. ● Assist with financial planning recommendations and implementation. ● Manage client information and maintain accurate records within the CRM. ● Work with client accounts held on the Charles Schwab custodial platform. ● Coordinate with the Financial Advisor to ensure outstanding client service. ● Handle planning, administrative and follow-up tasks independently. ● Help streamline internal processes and free up advisor capacity for business growth. We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running with minimal supervision. 4+ years' experience in a Paraplanner, Financial Planning Assistant or Client Relationship Manager role. Ability to work independently and proactively manage workloads. Comfortable speaking directly with clients via phone and video calls. Familiarity with SEC/FINRA compliance requirements. Due to the regulated nature of the financial services industry, the successful candidate must be willing to complete all required pre-employment compliance checks. blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.title: Growth Marketing Specialist
blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.description: GROWTH MARKETING SPECIALIST ROLE OVERVIEW BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences. This role is ideal for someone who: - Is an expert at hands-on execution - Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship - Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS - Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end. ABOUT BLACKBOX STRATEGIES BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients. LOCATION Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Cold Email & Outbound Execution - Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay - Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly - Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization - Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot - Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C) - Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages - Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns - Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene - Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp SMS Marketing (Nice to Have) - Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement) - Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus - Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing - Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy - Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration REQUIREMENTS - Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles - Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns - Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences - Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs - Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution - Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment BENEFITS - Competitive compensation - Flexible, fully remote work environment - Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue - Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership - Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

careerstrengo-careerstrengo:ashbyhq:b664.title: Junior Digital Customer Success Manager - Dutch speaking
careerstrengo-careerstrengo:ashbyhq:b664.description: Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up backed by a $36M Series A, we thrive on acceleration. We are looking for a pioneer to help us bridge the gap between human connection and digital efficiency. THE ROLE: DIGITAL-FIRST SUCCESS This is a newly created, hybrid role for someone who sits at the intersection of relationship management, data-driven marketing, and tech enthusiasm. You aren't just managing accounts; you can help co-create a proactive, tech-first customer journey. Your mission is to move away from traditional, constant 1:1 meetings toward scalable, tech-driven engagement. You will use data triggers and AI activation strategies to ensure our customers stay healthy and engaged at scale. WHAT YOUR DAY LOOKS LIKE - Scalable Activation: You’ll help design and execute outreach programs, in-app notifications, and webinars to drive deep product activation across your portfolio. - AI Champion: Your primary objective will be finding scalable ways to help customers implement and see the value of Trengo’s AI-driven features. - Data-Driven Strategy: You’ll use data triggers and CRM automations to identify which customers need a nudge and which are ready for expansion. - Proactive Engagement: While you focus on digital-first success, you are a strong proactive communicator who is ready to jump into meetings with customers when a personal touch is needed to drive growth. - Portfolio Management: You will take ownership of a segment of our business, allowing the team to focus on high-touch accounts while you master the art of a wider "one-to-many" success. WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU: - Experience: You have approximately one year of professional experience and are ready to continue growing your career in a fast-paced SaaS environment. - Tech & Data Savvy: You have a high degree of technical affinity. You are comfortable with automations and enjoy exploring how AI can optimize workflows. - Languages: You have business proficiency in both Dutch and English. You feel confident supporting our core Dutch market and collaborating internally in both languages. - Communication Style: You can translate complex technical topics into clear, actionable advice. You love talking to people but are also on top of activating customers through scalable channels like webinars or video content. - "Hacker" Mindset: You are a self-starter who is always looking for a more efficient, automated way to solve a manual problem. ⚙️ OUR TECH & AI MINDSET AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it's part of how we build and operate. You'll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? This is what we carefully prepared for you: - 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment. - 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad. - 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success. - 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp) https://openup.com/nl/. - 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences. - 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel - 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ. - 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected. - 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues. - 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office https://www.centralpark-utrecht.nl/en. - 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future. - 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to t

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:8d.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Diesel Technician to perform professional repair and maintenance work on heavy-duty equipment. The technician will be responsible for diagnosing and servicing a wide range of mechanical and electrical systems on commercial trucks and equipment. This role includes performing diagnostics and maintenance on aftertreatment systems, disc and shoe brake systems, transmissions and clutches, suspension components, tires and wheels, air conditioning systems, as well as electrical and lighting systems. The ideal candidate will be capable of accurately diagnosing issues and completing repairs efficiently while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
responsibilities: Perform onsite diagnostic and repair work on heavy-duty commercial vehicles.
Utilize OEM diagnostic software and tools (Cummins, PACCAR, Snap-on, JPRO, ECT) to efficiently identify and resolve issues.
Maintain accurate records of work performed and communicate with fleet managers or clients as needed.
Adhere to all safety protocols and company procedures.
Maintain punctuality and professionalism at all times.
Perform professional repair and maintenance on heavy-duty trucks and equipment.
Diagnose and service aftertreatment systems, including troubleshooting emissions-related issues.
Inspect, repair, and maintain disc and shoe brake systems.
Perform transmission and clutch maintenance or replacements as required.
Diagnose and repair suspension components to ensure proper vehicle performance and safety.
Complete tire and wheel maintenance, including inspections, replacements, and related repairs.
Diagnose and service air conditioning systems to ensure proper operation.
Troubleshoot and repair electrical systems and vehicle lighting.
Accurately document diagnostics, repairs, and completed work on service orders.
Follow company safety procedures and maintain a clean, organized work environment.
Communicate repair findings and recommendations with shop leadership or service management.
qualifications: Valid driver’s license
Previous experience performing repair and maintenance on heavy-duty trucks or equipment.
Strong ability to diagnose mechanical and electrical issues on commercial vehicles.
Experience working with aftertreatment systems, brake systems (disc and shoe), transmissions, clutches, suspension components, tires, and wheels.
Knowledge of air conditioning diagnostics and maintenance for heavy-duty equipment.
Ability to diagnose and repair electrical and lighting systems.
Familiarity with diesel engine systems and general heavy-duty truck components.
Ability to work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced shop environment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to properly document repairs and service work.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:5bceffb4-.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer - Engine
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:5bceffb4-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: Engine by Gen is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. Engine by Gen's mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action. In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. People take control of their finances with our innovative financial products and marketplace - including our full-fledged suite of features to save, borrow, spend, and invest - seamlessly bringing together the best offers and content from Engine by Gen and our 1,100+ Enterprise Partner network, together in one experience. Engine by Gen's enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Engine by Gen connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it. Key Responsibilities: - Design, build, and maintain infrastructure supporting ML training, deployment, and inference workloads. - Own and improve CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and operational tooling for ML systems. - Operate and evolve production systems with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. - Build and maintain Kubernetes- and cloud-based services that support model execution and data workflows. - Partner with data scientists and engineers to support model deployment and operational needs. - Improve developer workflows through automation, tooling, and platform abstractions. - Participate in on-call and operational ownership for platform components. About You: - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. - 7+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps/SRE roles. - Strong systems engineering background with production operations experience. - Strong experience with backend or platform services. - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and tooling (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring). - Experience operating distributed systems in production. - Experience with machine learning infra

ghj-ghj:lever:a98574bd-331f-469c-861f-16.description: Are you a detail-oriented accounting professional looking to join a growing organization where you can make an immediate impact? Our client is seeking a Senior Accounting Analyst to join its Corporate Accounting team. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced, acquisition-driven environment with exposure to lease accounting, financial reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. This position offers high visibility, opportunities for career growth, and the chance to help streamline accounting processes within a dynamic organization. Prepare and record journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting analyses to ensure accurate financial reporting. Perform monthly balance sheet account reconciliations and investigate variances. Review, maintain, and administer lease agreements in accordance with ASC 842. Assist with lease accounting activities, including lease modifications, renewals, and related accounting entries. Review landlord invoices, CAM reconciliations, and resolve landlord/tenant billing discrepancies. Collaborate with Accounts Payable to ensure expenses are properly coded and reconciled. Support month-end and year-end close activities. Participate in financial reporting, audit support, and SOX compliance activities. Analyze accounting processes and identify opportunities for automation and process improvements. Partner cross-functionally with operations, finance, and other internal stakeholders. Assist with ad hoc accounting projects and special analyses as assigned. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 4+ years of progressive accounting experience. Strong understanding of GAAP. Experience with lease accounting (ASC 842) preferred. Experience reviewing lease agreements, lease administration, or property accounting is highly desirable. Experience with CAM reconciliations, landlord invoices, or tenant billing is a plus. Strong general ledger, journal entry, and balance sheet reconciliation experience. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, etc.). Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. CPA or public accounting experience is a plus but not required. Lease accounting software experience. Property accounting or multi-location business experience. Experience supporting acquisitions or rapidly growing organizations. ERP system experience (Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains is a plus). Hybrid work schedule (Monday–Thursday onsite, Friday remote) Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits 401(k) with employer match Paid time off and annual performance reviews Opportunity to join a collaborative accounting team with strong leadership visibility Exposure to a growing organization with ongoing acquisitions and opportunities for process improvement and career advancement #GHJSS #LI-MO1

As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:23c0d03a-85dd-484e.title: Billing Operations Specialist
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:23c0d03a-85dd-484e.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Ми шукаємо Billing Operations Specialist — операційну роль у payments-напрямі з фокусом на білінг, платіжну інфраструктуру, fraud та chargebacks. Тут ти не лише допомагатимеш користувачам, а й працюватимеш із платіжними процесами, розслідуватимеш кейси, впливатимеш на якість сервісу та вдосконалюватимеш процеси разом із командою. Що ти будеш робити: — Моніторинг платіжної інфраструктури та ключових метрик; — Робота з платіжними інцидентами — failed payments, refunds, disputes/chargebacks; — Розслідування складних платіжних кейсів (unauthorized payments, chargeback threats, підозрілі транзакції, пошук root cause); — Комунікація з користувачами щодо платіжних питань (refund-запити, disputes, unauthorized payments) через ticket-based системи; — Робота з fraud-кейсами та аналіз fraud patterns;. — Взаємодія зі стейкхолдерами (product, support, payments, compliance); Очікування від кандидата: — Базове розуміння онлайн платежів та fraud patterns; — Англійська — B1+, розмовна та письмова. Для нас це важливо, тому що спілкуємося в основному з американцями; — Готовність працювати в нічні зміни (19:00 — 3:00); — Аналітичний підхід до розслідування проблем; — Вміння працювати в багатозадачному середовищі з частою зміною підходів — Вміння працювати з SLA та ескалаціями; — Бажання покращувати процеси та проактивно доносити власні ідеї Буде плюсом: — Практичний досвід — failed payments, refunds, disputes, розуміння chargeback lifecycle; — Досвід роботи з ticket-based системами (Zendesk або аналоги) — Готовність брати ownership за задачі і доводити їх до результату Формат роботи та графік: — Віддалена робота за замовчуванням; — Графік білінг-агента — 18–19 змін на місяць Зміни: Ранок: 07:00–15:00 День: 15:00–23:00 Вечір: 19:00–03:00 — Вечірні/нічні зміни — це переважно — operations, monitoring, робота з інцидентами (не non-stop дзвінки). Ми пропонуємо: — Реальний вплив на payments-процеси та бізнес; — Карʼєрне зростання, привʼязане до результатів, KPI та ownership; — Можливість нетворкінгу та обміну експертизою з колегами з інших команд та проєктів в межах холдингу; — Команда, де всі один за одного, де тобі максимально довіряють і надають простір для ініціатив, де 99% процесів налагоджені і описані; — Можливість перегляду зарплати відразу після закриття випробувального терміну та кожні пів року після. Отримання бонусів за гарний перформанс щомісяця; — Медичне страхування, лікарняні та 18 днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік; — Працюємо віддалено за замовчуванням. Ця роль добре підійде тобі, якщо ти: — Бачиш operations як простір для покращень і бізнес-зростання; — Любиш розбиратися, як працюють платежі; — Відчуваєш себе детективом, який обожнює досліджувати складні ситуації, аналізувати факти та докопуватися до її першопричини, запропонувати шляхи її вирішення; — Маєш безмежне бажання вчитися і розвиватися в IT. wattpad-wattpad:lever:a322eb2d-dec8-4c83.title: [Wattpad] Business Finance (FP&A) Manager
wattpad-wattpad:lever:a322eb2d-dec8-4c83.description: Wattpad’s vision is to entertain and connect the world through stories. A leading global webnovel platform, Wattpad has democratized storytelling for a new generation of diverse Gen Z writers and their fans. Wattpad is part of WEBTOON Entertainment’s IP & Creator Ecosystem, where approximately 155 million monthly active users discover incredible stories in multiple formats. Come build the future of entertainment and storytelling with our global team, and write your next chapter with us! Wattpad is part of the WEBTOON Entertainment family of brands, home to some of the world's largest storytelling platforms. With approximately 155 million monthly active users, WEBTOON Entertainment’s IP & Creator Ecosystem of aligned brands and platforms include WEBTOON, Wattpad--the world’s leading webnovel platform--WEBTOON Productions, Studio N, Studio LICO, WEBTOON Unscrolled, LINE MANGA, and eBookJapan, among others. To read more about our family of Brands, check out our website here. Wattpad follows a hybrid work model, with employees working from our vibrant downtown Toronto office 3x per week. The Finance team is seeking a Business Finance (FP&A) Manager to act as the P&L owner for Wattpad's overall business - driving improvements in business efficiency and profitability across the organization. Rather than pursuing simple cost reduction, this role champions ROI-driven decision making, evaluating all spend and investments based on the value they return to the business. The Manager will lead P&L management and financial modeling aligned with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and company strategy. A core mandate of this role is budget ownership and cost/efficiency management of company-wide spend - including hosting fees, all software and tools, cloud services, and security-related tools - as well as Marketing, Content, and Paid Content subscription spend, where the role is expected to strengthen cost efficiency and ROI. The role is also expected to actively leverage Google Workspace (GWS) and Claude AI to enhance the speed, depth, and productivity of financial planning and analysis.
responsibilities: Own the Wattpad P&L end-to-end - identify business inefficiencies and drive profitability-improvement initiatives with an ROI-first mindset, not simple cost cutting.

Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and strategic planning processes in partnership with the broader team, building and maintaining P&L forecasts and financial models that translate strategy into measurable financial outcomes.

Own budget management, cost control, and efficiency for all technology spend, including hosting fees, software and tools, cloud services, and security-related tools - monitor, analyze, and optimize company-wide usage and spend, partnering with Engineering, IT, Security, and vendors to align capacity and cost with business needs.

Drive cost efficiency and ROI improvement for Marketing, Content, and Paid Content subscription spend - analyze marketing campaign performance, content investment returns, and subscription monetization, partnering with Marketing and Content teams to maximize the return on every dollar spent.
Evaluate investments, initiatives, and vendor contracts on an ROI basis - build business cases and conduct post-investment reviews to guide resource allocation.
Act as a trusted finance business partner to leaders across Wattpad, delivering actionable insights on revenue, cost drivers, and margin improvement.
Actively leverage Google Workspace (GWS) and Claude AI to automate reporting, accelerate analysis, and enhance financial modeling and planning productivity.
Provide ad hoc financial analysis and decision support to Corporate Finance and leadership as needed.
qualifications: Minimum of 5 years’ FP&A, business finance, or corporate finance experience, including hands-on P&L management, budgeting/forecasting, and financial modeling.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and Google Workspace (GWS); demonstrated interest in applying AI tools such as Claude AI to finance workflows.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels.
Ability to work under tight deadlines with a high level of accuracy.
Solid understanding of P&L structure, ROI analysis, and budget/cost management across hosting fees, software, tools, cloud, and security-related tool spend.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
